# Verifying your identity: what you’ll need


nsave team


Jan 6, 2026


## Documents we may ask for


Document Example Check before uploading


Identity Passport or national identity card Current and undamaged


Address Bank statement or utility bill Name and address are visible


Tax details Local tax identification number Matches your application


## Taking a clear verification photo


### Common reasons a check needs another try


- The image is blurred or part of the document is outside the frame.
- The document has expired or the details do not match the application.
- Lighting hides security features or makes the text difficult to read.
